applies_why: The judge text declares a link UNDERDETERMINED, so the rule governing grounds for UNDERDETERMINED applies.
quote: UNDERDETERMINED -- [CR2] and [CR3] answered the loins/seed row with Genesis 46:26 and Hebrews 7:10 (loins at depth) and the legal/flesh distinction, while [DR3] presses that the only named Davidic man is Joseph; neither chain forces the other.
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.
room: I weighed whether 'neither chain forces the other' is a forbidden single-verse-silence or two-sense-openness ground for UNDERDETERMINED, or a permissible chain-balance reason; the text states only chain balance.
why: The judge's stated reason is that the competing chains do not force each other, not that a single verse fails to state the link or that a two-sense verse is open, so it does not do the thing K-S2 forbids.
